description.value: Riverside Court RV & Cabins is a small, family-owned property on the Granby River just outside downtown Grand Forks, operating on a site with roots going back to 1948. After severe 2018 flooding, the property was reinvented into two cabin units and ten RV sites, with a sandy beach and green space along the river. It is one block from downtown Grand Forks, making it a convenient overnight base for cyclists passing through on Highway 3.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for https://www.riversidecourtgf.com confirms this is a real, operating property at 7351 Hwy 3, Grand Forks, BC — formerly the Riverside Motel, now rebranded as Riverside Court RV & Cabins after 2018 flood damage. The site explicitly mentions public laundry, a small on-site store, and nearby restaurants/pubs/groceries within walking distance, which supports several amenity fields. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating accommodation on Highway 3 in Grand Forks BC with an active website and verifiable contact details; useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on the southern BC route.
enrichment_extras.notes: The property transitioned from a motel to a mixed RV/cabin format after 2018 flooding. The two cabin units (1 queen bed with kitchen each) and 10 RV sites represent the current accommodation offering. The on-site small store stocks ice, firewood, and ice cream but is not a full grocery.
